device.description: 12-bit 1 MSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: ads7042.pdf (SBAS608C) p.6 pin configuration and functions, p.7 recommended operating conditions, p.10 timing (Figure 1), p.20 transfer characteristics (Table 1), p.21 serial interface, p.22-24 offset calibration

pages: p.6 (pins), p.7 (ROC), p.10 (timing, Figure 1), p.20 (transfer characteristics), p.21 (serial interface), p.22-24 (offset calibration)
notModeled: analog input (single-ended input); conversion is clocked by SCLK (the 12.5-SCLK conversion is not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

offset calibration (power-up: the first frame after power-up outputs zeros while the OCR is calibrated with at least 16 SCLKs, which the 0 V code already is; the 32-SCLK calibration frame during normal operation)
throughput, acquisition time and SCLK frequency limits
tFloat: the datasheet gives only a 5 ns minimum for tDZ_CSDO
tOut uses tD_CKDO 30 ns (AVDD 1.8-3.6 V); at AVDD 1.65-1.8 V it is 50 ns
